archetype: 5 - Luxury (Cinematic & Moody Dark) with Archetype 7 Electric Blue Accents
design_philosophy: Ultra-premium, cinematic, high-contrast dark mode. Eliminate all generic 'agency template' layouts. Use aggressive negative space (30% less text, 2x more padding). The interface must feel expensive, immersive, and highly authoritative.

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter font-black text-white

spacing_and_layout.negative_space_rule: Enforce maximum breathing room. Elements should not be cramped. Containers must have p-8 or p-12 minimum.

effects.button_primary: bg-[#0057FF] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold hover:bg-[#004ACC] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,87,255,0.5)] transition-all duration-300

header.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#030303]/70 border-b border-white/5 transition-all

hero.composition: Central text block dominating the screen. Headline: 'L\'art de l\'excellence digitale.' with 'excellence' in electric blue gradient. Below the text: A massive floating laptop mockup overlapping a mobile mockup. The bottom edge of the viewport emits a cinematic blue planet-glow.
hero.animations: Subtle, continuous levitation (Y-axis translation) of the device mockups. Headline fades and slides up on load.

trust_bar.layout: Horizontal scrolling marquee or evenly spaced flex grid depending on screen size. High contrast, muted text.
trust_bar.content: Sectors: Cabinet Dentaire • Restauration • Institut de Beauté • Immobilier. Stats: +400% de conversion moyenne • Design sur-mesure • Performances extrêmes

services.card_design: Dark surface (#08080A), subtle 1px border (#1A1A24). Large padding (p-10). Lucide line icons in electric blue. On hover, the border lights up and casts a subtle blue inner glow.

portfolio.layout: Editorial Asymmetry. NOT a standard grid. Use a vertical scrolling stack where each project card alternates left/right alignment. The mockup takes 60% of the width, the typography takes 40%. Huge sector numbers (e.g., '01').
portfolio.card_style: No visible container background for the wrapper. The mockups themselves should be highly polished and drop a massive shadow on the black background.

process_timeline.layout: Horizontal timeline (flex-col on mobile, flex-row on desktop) with 4 glowing nodes.
process_timeline.style: A subtle horizontal line (white/10) connects the nodes. Each node is a circle with a glowing blue border. Text content sits below each node. Add scroll-reveal animations to light up the nodes sequentially.

cta_final.style: Massive py-32 section. Luminous blue atmospheric background (radial gradient center).
cta_final.content: Headline: 'Prêt à dominer votre marché ?'. Subtitle: 'Rejoignez l\'élite avec un site web ultra-premium.'. Button: 'Démarrer votre projet'

footer.bottom_bar: border-t border-white/5 pt-8 text-sm text-zinc-500 text-center

imagery_prompts.instructions: Use these prompts with an AI image generator to create the required assets for the interface mockups. Do NOT use generic placeholder images.
imagery_prompts.hero_mockups: High-end 3D render of a sleek metallic laptop and smartphone floating in a dark void. Cinematic studio lighting, reflections on the dark screen, electric blue ambient rim lighting from below. Ultra-realistic, 8k, architectural visualization style.
imagery_prompts.portfolio_dentaire: Ultra-premium website interface for a luxury dental clinic displayed on a 3D dark laptop monitor. The website design shows modern clean architectural lines, dark mode UI, elegant typography. Cinematic lighting.
imagery_prompts.portfolio_restaurant: Michelin-star fine dining website mockup on a sleek dark tablet screen. Moody lighting, high-contrast dark UI, electric blue accent buttons, showing a beautifully plated dish. Luxury digital design.
imagery_prompts.portfolio_beaute: High-end luxury beauty salon website design presented on a floating dark smartphone. Minimalist dark UI interface, elegant serif fonts, showing a sophisticated interior or premium skincare product.
imagery_prompts.portfolio_immobilier: Exclusive luxury real estate website interface mockup on a sleek desktop monitor in a dark studio. The screen displays a modern black architectural villa at night with cinematic lighting. Premium dark UI.

interactive_and_testing_rules.interactions: All hover states must be distinct. Avoid instantaneous changes; use transition-all duration-300 or 500.
interactive_and_testing_rules.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, links, and forms MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-services-link', data-testid='hero-cta-button').
